name: Mari El (Russia, 1992–2006)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, white and red in the ratio 1:6:1, with a red Mari ornament and the name 'Марий Эл' in red at the hoist of the white stripe.
history: The first flag of the Republic of Mari El, adopted in 1992, with a traditional Mari ornament and the republic's name at the hoist. It was replaced in 2006 by a version with a central ornament.

features.role: Mari ornament with inscription Марий Эл
